LanguageData.RimPipe_StorageTank.label: storage tank
LanguageData.RimPipe_StorageTank.description: Fluid storage tank. One container with local N/S/W/E ports. Pipes must sit on the cell outward from a port.
LanguageData.RimPipe_TeeJunction.label: tee junction
LanguageData.RimPipe_TeeJunction.description: Pipe tee junction. One container with local North/West/East ports (no South).
LanguageData.RimPipe_Pipe.label: pipe
LanguageData.RimPipe_Pipe.description: Fluid pipe cell. Carries cross-building Mapping topology only (does not store fluid). Uses vanilla PowerConduit art; link flag Custom1 so it does not merge with power conduits.
LanguageData.RimPipe_Valve.label: valve
LanguageData.RimPipe_Valve.description: Fluid valve. Local West/East ports; internal Mapping rate follows open/close. Closed rate is 0 without tearing down topology.
LanguageData.RimPipe_Pump.label: pump
LanguageData.RimPipe_Pump.description: Fluid pump. Local West inlet / East outlet. When open and powered, forced one-way full rate ignoring pressure equalize. Closed or unpowered rate is 0 without tearing topology.
LanguageData.RimPipe_HeatExchanger.label: heat exchanger
LanguageData.RimPipe_HeatExchanger.description: Fluid heat exchanger. Local West/East chambers; when open, conducts heat to equalize temperatures without moving fluid mass. Closed heat rate is 0 without tearing topology.
LanguageData.RimPipe_Dev_Tank.label: rimpipe test tank
LanguageData.RimPipe_Dev_Tank.description: Stage-1 acceptance tank. One container with local N/S/W/E ports. Pipes must sit on the outward port cell.
LanguageData.RimPipe_Dev_TankLarge.label: rimpipe test tank (large)
LanguageData.RimPipe_Dev_TankLarge.description: Stage-3 3.1 pressure acceptance large tank (capacity 500). Debug / DefOf only.
LanguageData.RimPipe_Dev_Tee.label: rimpipe test tee
LanguageData.RimPipe_Dev_Tee.description: Stage-1 acceptance tee. One container with local North/West/East ports (no South).
LanguageData.RimPipe_Dev_Pipe.label: rimpipe test pipe
LanguageData.RimPipe_Dev_Pipe.description: Stage-1 acceptance pipe cell. Topology only (does not store fluid). Uses vanilla conduit atlas + Custom1 link.
LanguageData.RimPipe_Dev_Reactor.label: rimpipe test reactor
LanguageData.RimPipe_Dev_Reactor.description: Chem-C Dev three-chamber reactor (LOX+RP-1→exhaust). Switch + power. Debug / DefOf only.
LanguageData.RimPipe_Dev_InternalBridge.label: rimpipe test internal bridge
LanguageData.RimPipe_Dev_InternalBridge.description: ExtHook-A Dev dual-chamber internal bridge via IPipeInternalMappingContributor. Debug / DefOf only.
